FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 342
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, & Public Safety Sponsor: Senator William Beasley
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 342 as introduced would allow K-9 officers employed by the Department of
Corrections (DOC) that retired on or after January 1, 2022, to be eligible to retire as a state
policeman and receive state police retirement benefits.
Pursuant to Section 36-27-26, Code of Alabama 1975, the fiscal impact of this bill will be
provided once the actuarial estimate is received from the Retirement Systems of Alabama.
